_doc: Build-arch families. This is a compile-time vocabulary kept separate from deploy/collection arch_id. Server slices are not deployment identities. Seed values mirror the active arch resolver and common.mk gencode tokens.
_deploy_doc: deploy_arch_ids are the only tokens with a populated ArchProfile card and a place in the frozen label_admitted.json arch enum. build_only_tokens are compile/SASS-coverage slices (e.g. the Hopper wgmma kernels gated sm_90a); they must never appear in a supported_arches list or a label arch field.
